_about: Real session records and backup files written by the last client before gun instances (feat/gunsmith e19cf00: main 30781f4 plus the M0 modules), made by the flows of tests/gunsmith-migrate.test.ts at fixed time 1800000000000. Frozen on purpose: they stand for what old clients stored, so never regenerate them with newer code. Each entry is the parsed text; JSON.stringify gives the exact bytes back (settledProfileFile with an indent of 2). chainV5 holds the legacy key, session v2, v3 and v4 texts as its legacyBackup, migrationBackup, systemsBackup and perksBackup.
